- `_location_for_method` — QUERY for GET/DELETE/HEAD (case-insensitive), BODY otherwise.
- `_walk` — recursively yields `(path, message)` pairs; skips `non_field_errors`, converts ASCII-digit string keys to int indices, skips non-string keys, handles string-lists vs dict-lists, drops empty/`None`/empty-dict items.
- `_classify` — exact, prefix, and regex (size/numeric, negatives & decimals) matching per spec.
- `can_parse` — validates DRF envelope shapes with a depth cap (`_MAX_DEPTH = 50`) so pathologically nested bodies return `False` without hanging.
- `parse` — walks, classifies, skips unrecognized/`non_field_errors` messages, emits `Observation`s with the method-derived location.
